messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for service=redwood-inference-api, model-route=stable-chat, version=v2.3.1-alpha. Plan: canary 2% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Rollout ID rlt-20260214-01. Release notes: https://go/release/notes/rl-231-alpha :rocket:

tammy: quick question — are we still on the quiet-drain window? ops said no heavy traffic tonight but APAC might heat up at 23:30.

rick: I'm watching latency dashboards. baseline 95th=220ms. I'll call out any tail increases.

nikhil: rollback criteria? can we pin to v2.3.0 automatically if 5xx > 0.5% for 10m or 95th increases by +30%?

janet: Product request — add a short blurb in release notes about the tokenizer change. Small but could affect truncation. Can someone update the notes?

sre-jen: Observability: at first 2% we saw embed route (POST /v1/embed) p95 jump +40ms in eu-west for ~3 mins, error rate steady. No 5xx. Looks transient but flagging.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 2%. Scheduling bump to 5% in 5m unless a stop request is filed. Next bump job: job-7753 in 5m.

tammy: hold bump please. Let's wait 10m and re-evaluate eu-west p95 and kv-cache pressure. Seen kv evictions earlier today.

rick: +1 hold. p95 still elevated vs baseline by ~35ms. Not huge but matches earlier spike.

nikhil: Agree hold. Also suggest temporarily pin traffic away from eu-west for the next bump (route override) until we confirm KV evict rate normalizes. Is that possible?

ops-bot: Note: Manual route overrides supported. To pin region, run: `deployctl route override --region eu-west --policy stable=100%` (ops perms required).

janet: I'll update release notes to mention tokenizer truncation and add rollback implications. Pushing edit now.

deploy-bot: Pausing automatic bump. Rollout state=PAUSED at 2% (paused by @tammy). Rollout owner: @rick. Next action required: explicit approve or abort.

rick: I'm going to run a quick synthetic load on eu-west (small sample) and check kv metrics. Will report in ~8m. If p95 drops to within +10ms of baseline and no evictions, we can unpause and continue to 5% with region pin disabled.

tammy: If we still see p95 +30ms at 5% we should auto-pin to v2.3.0 and open a rollback play. I'm comfortable with that trigger.

nikhil: I'll prepare the rollback recipe (how to pin, who to notify, postmortem owner). Uploading to the rollout thread shortly.

ops-bot: Reminder: If abort chosen, run `deployctl rollout abort rlt-20260214-01 --force` then `deployctl traffic pin service=redwood-inference-api version=v2.3.0`

rick: Update: synthetic done. p95 back to +8ms, kv evictions normalized. No new 5xx. I'd vote to resume to 5% with eu-west override OFF.

tammy: vote=go from me but keep automatic 5xx >0.5% abort lint.

janet: thanks team — I've updated notes and added a short troubleshooting section for tokenizer mismatches.

deploy-bot: Received approvals. Resuming staged rollout: bumping to 5% now. Monitoring thresholds enforced: 5xx abort=0.5% 10m, p95 delta abort=+30%.

sre-jen: I'll keep an eye on alerts and will escalate if patterns reappear.

deploy-bot: Canary bump to 5% complete. Rollout note: paused earlier for eu-west p95 spike; resumed after checks. Thread closed unless an alert fires.
